name: issue_1159_mild_day_occupant_off_kept_through_grace
description: Mild day (classification hvac_mode off), indoor 76F above the 74F comfort ceiling, so Climate Advisor is cooling. At 12:00 the occupant switches the thermostat Off. Climate Advisor confirms it at 12:10 as a manual change and keeps it for the 60-minute manual grace. The 12:30 classification refresh must not switch cooling back on.
source: Issue #1159 (design gap since #249: the 'off' classification is a label, CA arms the band)
notes: Occupant: on a mild day you switch the thermostat Off. Before the fix the confirm window ended as 'self-resolved' (Off equalled the label off), no grace, no notice, and the next refresh wrote cool again within half an hour.

(a) Effectiveness: tests/test_override_off_mild_day.py is revert-proven (override_confirmed missing, cool re-commanded at the refresh). This pending scenario is the production-harness mirror; run it with the fix reverted and the 12:10 override_confirmed and 12:35 override_active assertions fail.
(b) Docs<->production: docs/grace-periods-spec.md State Machine ('An occupant's Off on a mild day (Issue #1159)').
(c) User outcome if this regresses: the occupant's Off is silently undone within 30 minutes with no notice, every mild day.
The 12:30 refresh uses day_type warm (still hvac_mode off) so it is not event-deduped against the 12:01 mild classification.

events.note: Mild day: classification mode off, but the comfort-edge selector arms cool at the ceiling (indoor above 74F).
Occupant switches the thermostat Off -> override detection, 10-min confirm window.
Confirm window elapses -> override confirmed (was: self-resolved), 60-minute manual grace starts.
30-minute refresh inside the grace: must not switch cooling back on.

assertions.reason: The occupant's Off is confirmed as a manual change, like on hot or cold days.
The refresh inside the manual grace does not switch heating or cooling back on.
The override and its grace survive the refresh (not adopted as 'automation agrees').

verdict.summary: An occupant's Off on a mild day is kept through the manual grace instead of being undone at the next refresh.
verdict.observed_behavior: Off at 12:00 -> override confirmed 12:10 -> 12:30 refresh leaves the thermostat Off -> override still active at 12:35.
verdict.expected_behavior: grace-periods-spec State Machine: an Off is a real manual change on every day type unless CA itself is holding HVAC off for an open door/window.
